# LLMS.TXT — PRANAV DWIVEDI

> Pranav Dwivedi (Pranav Pramod Dwivedi, PR4NAV — No. 07).
> **Software engineer by craft. Cricketer by record.**
> Founder of Stargaze — independent software branch: autonomous agents,
> local-first tools, computer vision. Captain / all-rounder of Destroyers CC,
> Rewa: 3,289 runs, 118 wickets, 216* off 56 balls, 8/39, six centuries, and
> three straight ABV Memorial titles (2024 · 2025 · 2026).
> The record does the talking.

## The record, one line

53 matches · 3,289 runs (43.74 / 73.58 / 60.58 by format) · 118 wickets · best
8/39 · highest 216* (56 balls: 22×4, 17×6, SR 385.71) · 6 hundreds · 26 fifties ·
385 fours · 160 sixes · 19 derby wins as captain · 3× champion.
